lead.event: BEI removes high-concentration stocks from IHSG calculation
lead.headline: BEI removes HSC stocks from IHSG calculation through 29 January
lead.blurb: As the change took effect on 2 November, the IHSG opened down 1.41% at 4,981. The measure removes Barito Renewables (BREN) and other high-concentration stocks from the calculation, though they remain tradable. Their weights are redistributed among remaining constituents, leaving 837 issuers in the calculation.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to lead

earnings_guidance.event: Merdeka Gold Resources reports Pani Mine production growth
earnings_guidance.headline: EMAS reports 69% quarterly production growth at Pani Mine
earnings_guidance.blurb: Merdeka Gold Resources produced 26,331 ounces in Q3 2026 as heap-leach ramp-up continued; cash costs excluding royalties and silver credits fell 13% quarter on quarter to USD778 per ounce. Its CIL Stage I facility is under construction, with commissioning targeted for 2028.

earnings_guidance.headline: OMED raises 2026 revenue target to around Rp2.5 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Jayamas Medica lifted its previous Rp2.3 trillion goal, implying about 21% year-on-year growth, citing sales volume growth and production efficiency. Nine-month net sales rose 26.1% year on year, while EBITDA and current-period profit increased 34.0% and 31.6%, respectively.

earnings_guidance.event: Bayan Resources reports nine-month 2026 net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BYAN reports 12.93% nine-month 2026 net profit growth to USD589.67 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: For the period ended 30 September, revenue was USD2.43 billion, roughly flat year on year, while gross profit rose to USD864.03 million from USD773.35 million. Earnings per share increased to USD0.018 from USD0.016, and total assets reached USD3.49 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Telkom reports nine-month 2026 revenue growth and lower attributable profit
earnings_guidance.headline: TLKM reports 3.55% revenue growth and lower attributable profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Telkom's January-September revenue reached Rp113.50 trillion, up from Rp109.61 trillion a year earlier, while attributable profit fell to Rp14.44 trillion from Rp15.03 trillion. Internet and mobile data services contributed Rp56.57 trillion, and IndiHome Rp19.12 trillion.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRIS addresses its free-float shortfall and planned rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS plans rights issue as free float stands at 9.33%
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia is discussing an issue of up to 6.8 billion Series B shares at a nominal Rp500 each with stakeholders to meet the IDX’s 15% minimum. IDX says the threshold could be met if its three controlling shareholders do not exercise or transfer their pre-emptive rights, but no commitment has been received. The exercise price and timeline remain under discussion.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: MBMA seeks approval for a private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MBMA seeks approval for private placement of up to 10.79 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Battery Materials will put the proposal to shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting on 8 December. The new shares would have a Rp100 nominal value each and could increase paid-in capital by up to 10%, with the company aiming to strengthen its capital structure.
